routine_code: Two letter code of measurement routine (** for manual operation)
time: UT date and time for beginning of measurement, yyyymmddThhmmssZ (ISO 8601)
routine_count: Routine count (1 for the first routine of the day, 2 for the second, etc.)
repetition_count: Repetition count (1 for the first set in the routine, 2 for the second, etc.)
duration: Total duration of measurement set in seconds (=# if the line is a comment line)
saturation_index: Saturation index: positive integer is the number of saturated cycles included in the data, negative integer is the number of cycles skipped due to saturation
filterwheel_pos1: Position of filterwheel #1, 0=filterwheel not used, 1-9 are valid positions
filterwheel_pos2: Position of filterwheel #2, 0=filterwheel not used, 1-9 are valid positions
pointing_zenith_angle: Pointing zenith angle in degree, absolute or relative (see next column), 999=tracker not used
zenith_pointing_mode: Zenith pointing mode: zenith angle is... 0=absolute, 1=relative to sun, 2=relative to moon
pointing_azi: Pointing azimuth in degree, increases clockwise, absolute (0=north) or relative (see next column), 999=tracker not used
azi_pointing_mode: Azimuth pointing mode: like zenith angle mode but also fixed scattering angles relative to sun (3) or moon (4)
head_sens_temp: Temperature in head sensor [°C], 999=no temperature signal
elec_temp1: Temperature at electronics board 1 [°C], 999=no temperature signal
elec_temp2: Temperature at electronics board 2 [°C], 999=no temperature signal
head_sens_hum: Humidity in head sensor [%], -9=no humidity signal
head_sens_pres: Pressure in head sensor [hPa], -9=no pressure signal
scale_factor: Scale factor for data (to obtain unscaled data and uncertainty divide then by this number)
